base_plate.provenance: Warm: 23.5 C marker mean in run _1. Cold: highest recorded ch1 voltage in run _3 assigned nominal 77 K at user request.

sample.provenance: User-reported sample warm reading 28.08 mV and approximate LN2 reading 619 mV. The earlier stated room temperature 23.5 C is assumed for the new warm reading; it was not independently supplied with that reading.

limitations: Two-point linear interpolation; intermediate temperatures are not independently validated.
Both cold references assume sensor equilibrium at nominal 77 K; no pressure correction.
Sample cold voltage is approximate, not the mean of an identified stable interval.
Sample warm temperature is assumed to be the earlier reported 23.5 C.
Base plate and sample use different curves. Values outside each reference interval are left blank and flagged; raw readings are always preserved.
The later base plate reading near 431.9 mV is preserved as an observation, not substituted for the recorded 23.5 C reference.
